scripts.publish:prod: rm -rf node_modules && yarn && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("default")' &&  expo publish && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("staging")'
scripts.deploy:ios:prod: rm -rf node_modules && yarn && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("default")' &&  expo build:ios && expo upload:ios && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("staging")'
scripts.deploy:android:prod: rm -rf node_modules && yarn && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("default")' && expo build:android -t app-bundle && expo upload:android && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("staging")'

scripts.deploy:ios:staging: rm -rf node_modules && yarn && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("staging")' && expo build:ios --release-channel staging && expo upload:ios
scripts.deploy:android:staging: rm -rf node_modules && yarn && node -e 'require("./updateExpoAppFile").init("staging")' && expo build:android -t app-bundle --release-channel staging && expo upload:android
